title_zh: 吹牛做红烧肉惹来烟雾报警器
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (13/20): Bragging About Braised Pork Sets Off the Smoke Alarm
note_en: 一边……一边…… describes two actions happening at the same time: 小伟一边炒菜一边得意地给大家讲解秘诀 "Xiao Wei proudly explained his secrets while he cooked." English uses "while" or an -ing phrase, but Chinese puts 一边 in front of each verb phrase, and both actions get equal weight; that's exactly why the pork burned.
